name: anki-study-agent
description: Orchestrate a registered local Card Service to create evidence-backed Anki study tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Create evidence-backed Anki cards with a trusted local runtime.
interface.longDescription: Inspect authorized local text, capability-advertised text-layer PDFs, static web, and YouTube subtitle sources; discover learning objectives with the fixed Hermes Grok 4.5 authorization preset; generate validated text cards; export APKG; and verify imported Anki data. Scanned PDF/OCR, full media acquisition, runtime rendering, playback, and restart verification are not yet provided.
defaultPrompt: 先检查本地 Card Service，再把这个受支持的素材做成可验证卡片。
从这个字幕或文本中选出 10 个值得主动表达的英语词块。
继续轮询上次返回的制卡任务，并准确报告当前阶段。
